Name: RSV World Map Size change
Author: ShenXL192168
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

This mod is designed to work alongside [b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24210]World Maps everywhere at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] [/b]. It automatically adjusts the display size of maps related to [b]Ridgeside Village (RSV)[/b], ensuring a consistent and harmonious visual scale across all in‑game map screens. No more mismatched map sizes – enjoy a seamless and unified map browsing experience.
[compare before=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51940/51940-1788882095-82274586.png]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51940/51940-1788882098-1253853495.png[/compare]

Manifest.Name: RSV World Map Size change
Manifest.Description: Makes Ridgeside Village world map use the vanilla 300x180 map footprint without replacing RSV's LooseSprites/RSVWorldMap asset; scales map hotspots to match. Designed for RSV 2.5.17 + World Maps Everywhere/NPC Map Locations.
Manifest.Author: ShenXL192168
